messages:
Alice Ramos: Heads up — vendor sent RMA 4x A100 to our NL warehouse but allocations show DE and IE. Need re-route or split? This blocks replacements for two clusters.
Ben Cho: Which SKUs? can we patch with spare pool?
Alice Ramos: Serials: S/N AX1234, AX1235, AX1236, AX1237. They arrived under PO 5043-RMA. Warehouse flagged customs code missing on proforma -> hold.
Marco (NexaSupply): Sorry — our packing list used HS 8471.80; NL customs requires ECCN + EORI on proforma. We can reissue PROFORMA but need confirmation which warehouse will accept (AMS vs FRA).
Carla Müller: We prefer AMS (NL) since closer to eu-west-1 region. Can you add insurance value and declare 'replacement parts' to avoid VAT hold?
Marco (NexaSupply): We can add insurance. Declaring 'replacement' will require supporting old serials on paperwork. Send S/N list and PO ref.
Dmitri Petrov: Reminder: if you route to FRA we have import team but lead times + customs there are slower (avg 5 business days). AMS usually 48-72h. Cost delta: air freight + customs fee ~€450 per unit. Sea consolidation not possible — urgent.
Elena Singh: Can vendor consolidate these RMAs with the outbound reserved shipment on 2026-03-25 to save freight? That shipment is going via forwarder XYZ AWB: 987-1234567.
Marco (NexaSupply): We can consolidate but AWB mismatch needs manifest update and new proforma. Also forwarding charge + €120 admin. ETA if consolidated: +24h delay for docs; overall still faster than separate air.
Alice Ramos: Accounting needs proforma to include incoterm DAP, insurance value, and 'replacement goods — non-commercial' note. Also we need invoice for warranty claim to escalate DOA replacement.
Marco (NexaSupply): Understood. I'll push updated proforma by EOD. Can you confirm EORI: GB123456789? Also confirm contact at AMS warehousing to pre-alert.
Ben Cho: EORI is GB123456789 for Redwood EU ops. Pre-alert to ams-ops@redwood.com. Also record codes for cluster tags: aws-node-rl-inf-1 & aws-node-rl-inf-2.
Vendor Logistics Bot: AWB 987-1234567 created. Tracking: https://track.example/awb/987-1234567 Status: Manifested. ETA AMS 2026-04-17 09:00Z
Alice Ramos: Thanks. Quick note: two units are DOA in our cluster, can vendor expedite priority replacement stock (RMX-SKU-A100-P) instead of refurbished?
Marco (NexaSupply): Priority replacement available but requires approved RMA chargeback form. Cost difference €1500/unit express processing. Need PO auth.
Dmitri Petrov: We approve express for one unit only — keep second as standard. Please split AWB: one express (air) and one standard, and label accordingly.
Marco (NexaSupply): Split AWBs issued: AIR AWB 987-1234567-1 (priority), STD AWB 987-1234567-2 (standard). I've emailed proforma + new manifest.
Vendor Logistics Bot: Document uploaded: proforma_1812223333.pdf (s3://nexasupply/proforma_1812223333.pdf).
Carla Müller: :thumbsup: Once proforma uploaded I'll pass to customs broker. Please cc customs@redwood-eu.com.
Alice Ramos: Thanks all. I'll update infra ticket INF-742 with tracking and serials. Closing note — can finance reimburse the extra €120 admin + €1500 express? Ping finance.
Ben Cho: I'll open a finance ticket and attach the proforma + manifest.
